northumbriaConstruct.summary: I founded Northumbria Construct as an industry–academia initiative to help connect students and emerging professionals with universities, professional institutions and the construction industry.
northumbriaConstruct.purpose: Its activities are designed to create practical routes into professional knowledge and networks through debates, seminars, site visits, webinars and collaborative projects.

academicExperience.summary: Selected academic assessments applying digital construction, BIM and information management principles to complex building design, delivery and facilities-management scenarios.

assessments.title: Digital Consultancy Report on Northumberland Street (NLDS) Facility
assessments.summary: A retrofit-focused consultancy report proposing a green-roof strategy for the NLDS facility and examining how BIM can improve energy analysis, cost estimation and information management. It extends the approach into facilities management through BIM-enabled predictive maintenance, IoT and energy monitoring.

assessments.title: CIS Building Delivery Challenge Identification and Resolution Proposal
assessments.summary: A delivery proposal for Northumbria University's CIS Building identifying circulation, MEP coordination and lift-integration challenges. It develops practical resolutions using Integrated Project Delivery, BIM, virtual reality, clash detection and ISO 19650-aligned information-management workflows.

norcon.summary: NorCon Projects is an emerging lightweight Project Operating System being developed to address fragmented project information, controls and collaboration through a clearer working structure.
norcon.purpose: The product direction is intended for small project teams and emerging project professionals. It focuses on accessible governance, document and reporting workflows, with an emphasis on clarity rather than unnecessary complexity.
principles: Structured project set-up, governance and permissions
Document ingestion, intelligence and version control
Change control, benefits and sustainability tracking
